rule: every record derived from radar points is a mean over at least 20 points; no point positions or series

dataset.label: 2020-2026, ground reference
dataset.source: TerraSAR-X descending, newer processing: fullpixel_20260921155333.csv, 2020-01-08 to 2026-08-24, 213 passes
dataset.frame: ground: on every pass the median displacement of 499 coherent ground points (below 5 m above ground, coherence above 0.6), shared with the 2014-2023 processing as unique mutual-nearest pairs, is subtracted; rates are relative to that ground, not absolute. Adopted by the team on 5 October 2026

sources.radar: TerraSAR-X point set provided for the course by R.F. Hanssen; aggregates only
sources.weather: KNMI station 344 Rotterdam, daily TG, TN, TX and UG, from the KNMI daily-data service https://www.daggegevens.knmi.nl/klimatologie/daggegevens (2014-2023 file of 2 September 2026, 2020-01-01 to 2026-10-03 fetched 5 October 2026); licence CC BY 4.0
sources.soundings: NOAA IGRA2, De Bilt (NLM00006260), 2019-2026, public domain
